light.$description: Light theme. Overrides Layer 2 semantics ONLY, emitted under [data-theme="light"]. Layer 1 primitives are never redefined per theme: when a value must change between themes, the fix is to point the semantic alias at a different primitive, not to redefine the primitive. Anything absent here inherits its dark value on purpose, which is why text.on-primary and primary.solid are not listed.

surface.$description: Elevation runs the other way in light: raised means whiter, not lighter grey. overlay and raised share a value because the neutral ramp tops out at white, so an overlay is separated from a raised card by its shadow instead. That is the normal light-theme convention.

text.$description: Amber text has to drop a long way in lightness to survive on a near-white surface. amber.text at L 0.856 lands near 1.2:1 here, which is invisible. This is the single most likely token for someone to 'simplify' back to the brand value; doing so would delete the text.
